paragraphs.text: Quote or forward whole messages in DeepSeek Harness Web — one-action quoting, right-Sidebar multi-se
lect, durable message metadata, and cross-session forwarding
# dsh-better-quotes
**Quote or forward whole messages in DeepSeek Harness Web — one click, one bundle, every identity th
rd whole messages in DeepSeek Harness Web — one click, one bundle, every identity the model needs.**
Select-to-quote copies text fragments that forget where they came from. This plugin quotes the *whol
e message* — user, steering, or assistant — together with its sender, time, identity, model route, s
kills, references, and attachments, wrapped in one bounded bundle the model can read and look up aga
ls, references, and attachments, wrapped in one bounded bundle the model can read and look up again.
## Features
- **One control, two outcomes.** Click the quote icon between Copy and Fork to quote that message im
mediately; hold it (or press `Shift+Enter`) to open multi-select. The transcript gains no extra chec

kboxes or toolbars.
- **Whole-message multi-select.** Pick any user, steering, and finalized assista
nt messages from the right-Sidebar **Quotes** tab. The transcript never scrolls, blanks, or gets cov

ered while you choose.
- **Durable metadata.** Every quoted message carries sender role, time, `sess
ion_id`, `seq`, `message_id`, provider/model, loaded skills, `@session` references, and image/file a

ttachments with names, sizes, and dimensions.
- **One bounded bundle.** A single `<quoted_messages>`
envelope replaces N disconnected blockquotes — the model reads the quote as context and can query t

he original events by identity.
- **Cross-session forwarding.** Send the same bundle to any other lo

cal Session as non-instruction reference context, from the same panel.
- **Click to locate.** Sent b
undle cards start folded; clicking an item scrolls to the source and highlights it, unfolding collap

sed process groups first. Cards from other sessions say so and hide navigation.
- **A quote chip tha
t reads like a label.** The composer shows a one-line summary (count and message previews) instead o

f raw envelope tags.
- **Local-first.** No external requests, no analytics, no remote services — eve
rything runs inside your DSH process.
## Quick start
[代码示例省略，未执行]
From a DSH source checkout, use `pnpm dsh plugin` instead of `dsh plugin`. Restart `dsh web` or refr
esh the browser. The package targets DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0`.
Once published to npm:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## How it works
### Quote one message
Click the icon between Copy and Fork. The message enters the composer immediately, matching the offi
cial select-to-quote interaction. The quote chip shows a one-line summary — quoted count and message
previews — and carries the bundle inside the same quote.
### Quote or forward several

1. Hold the same icon for half a second, or press `Shift+Enter`.
2. The Quotes tab opens in the righ
t Sidebar with that message selected, its list starting at the newest messages. Click rows to toggle

selection, search to narrow the list, and use the single all/none control for what is shown.
3. Cho
ose **Insert quote (N)** to place one bundle in the composer, or **Forward** to pick another local S

ession and send the same bundle. Either action collapses the Sidebar when it completes.
4. The targe
t excludes the current Session and subagent Sessions.
### Locate
Sent bundle cards start folded. Expand one and click a same-Session item to scroll to the rendered o
riginal and briefly highlight it. Folded process groups are expanded first. Forwarded cards show **F
rom another session** and hide source navigation.
## Bundle format
One insert creates one envelope; the composer draft prefixes the summary line its quote chip shows,
and once sent the card owns that line so the transcript shows only the card:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`session_id` + `seq` let the model read the original event with `session_event_read`; `message_id` i
s omitted when the host does not expose one. `<skill>` and `<reference>` record loaded skills and `@
session` labels. `[attachment …]` records durable image/file ids, names, sizes, media types, and dim
ensions. Literal boundary tags in message text are escaped.
Attachments are referenced, not copied. If history compaction removes the original, image pixels may
be unavailable; files remain readable only while their saved path is in history.
## Model lookup
Mount the optional session query tools when the model should read source events:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The bundle remains readable without it, but cannot be queried by identity.
## Compatibility and privacy
- `insertQuote` is used when the host exposes it; older hosts fall back to `insertText` at the caret

.
- The selector reads the Chat snapshot through standard Session props; it does not scrape the DOM.

- Forwarding stays inside the local DSH process and only targets Sessions the client lists.
- No ex

ternal HTTP requests, analytics, or remote services.
- All text is React-rendered; stylesheet classe
s are prefixed `bq-`.
## How it compares
Public READMEs as of **2026-10-26**.
| Plugin | Selection entry | Quote shape | Cross-Session forwarding | Durable identity |
| **dsh-better-quotes** | One action: click quotes, hold multi-selects in the right Sidebar | One bo
unded `<quoted_messages>` bundle | Yes, same tab | `session_id`, `seq`, `message_id`, time, route, s

kills, references |
| dsh-message-forward | Long-press multi-select; forward dialog | Forwarding con

text | Yes | Source session and speaker |
| dsh-quote-followup | Selection toolbar; text | Quote chi

ps | No | Text selection |
| dsh-select-quote | Selection toolbar; text | Stacked cards | No | Text

selection |
| dsh-quote-annotate-pro | Selection toolbar; text and annotations | Anchored quote bloc

ks | No | Turn/role anchors |
[该节后续省略]
## Limitations and roadmap

- Multi-select lives in the right Sidebar, not as per-row checkboxes in the transcript.
- Locate onl

y works inside the source Session.
- Attachments are referenced, not re-attached; thumbnails and re-

attachment remain future work.
- Only the loaded, visible Chat window is listed.
- No browser E2E or

t remain future work.
- Only the loaded, visible Chat window is listed.
- No browser E2E or GIF yet.
